To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a net model of a system is a good starting point to analyze the system's functional and performance aspects; and (2) a net model is a good target model for the analysis of the system's functional aspects.

1. the interleaving of functional and performance structural analysis of Petri Net models allows us to obtain a more precise analysis of both the functional and performance properties; 2. the interleaving is possible thanks to the use of the theory of the stochastic Petri Nets;

(i) the performance analysis of a Petri net can be performed by using a functional analysis technique (namely, the reachability tree); (ii) the functional analysis of a Petni net can be performed using a performance analysis technique (namore, a performance model); (iii) the performance analysis can be used to improve the functional analysis, and the functional analysis to improve the performance analysis; and (iv) the functional analysis is a prerequisite for the performance analysis
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of analysis techniques for performance evaluation of systems described by Petri nets.
the development of techniques for the analysis of Petri Net models, and with their application to the design of concurrent systems.
the development and application of Petri Nets based techniques for the specification and performance evaluation of concurrent systems, with particular emphasis on parallel and distributed systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interleaving of functional and performance analysis theories is a very important research direction, which can be very fruitful.
the interleaved analysis techniques are a good way of developing the theory of Petri nets and of applying the theory to practical problems.
, for the class of models we consider, the functional and the structural performance analysis are not alternative, but complementary approaches.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in order to perform a functional analysis of Petri Nets we need performance information and, to do performance analysis, we need functional information.
the interleaving of functional and performance Petri Net analysis techniques has been a very useful tool for the development of new techniques for each analysis.
we have developed a methodology for the performance evaluation of Petri Net models, based on the interleaving of functional and performance analysis techniques.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the functional and the quantitative analysis of Petri nets should be interleaved.

, by combining the functional and performance analysis, it is possible to develop more effective analysis techniques for the performance evaluation, and to obtain a more complete picture of the behavior of the system, including both its functional and performance aspects.

the use of a single formalism for the description and analysis of the functional and performance specifications of a distributed system allows the designer to exploit the synergies between the two aspects.
